sections.shortTitle: Control of Narcotic Substances Amendment Ordinance 2000
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

CONTROL OF NARCOTIC SUBSTANCES
CONTROL OF
NARCOTIC SUBSTANCES
(AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2000
ORDINANCE LXVI OF
2000
An Ordinance to
amend the Control of Narcotic Substances Act, 1997
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 23rd December, 2000]
F.No.2(1)/2000-Pub., dated 23-12-2000.---The following
Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called the Control of Narcotic
Substances (Amendment) Ordinance, 2000.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Control of Narcotic Substances Amendment Ordinance 2000
sections.description:
Amendment of section 33, Act XXV of 1997

CONTROL OF NARCOTIC SUBSTANCES
CONTROL OF
NARCOTIC SUBSTANCES
(AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2000
ORDINANCE LXVI OF
2000
An Ordinance to
amend the Control of Narcotic Substances Act, 1997
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 23rd December, 2000]
F.No.2(1)/2000-Pub., dated 23-12-2000.---The following
Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general information:--
2. Amendment of section 33,
Act XXV of 1997.---In the Control of Narcotic Substances Act, 1997 (XXV of
1997) hereinafter referred to as the said Act, in section 33,---
(a) in
subsection (2), for the second proviso, the following shall be substituted,
namely:-
"Provided further that if
any such article other than a narcotic drug, psychotropic substance or
controlled substance is liable to speedy and natural decay or in case of a
vehicle, the Director-General, Anti-Narcotic Force, or any other officer
authorised by notification in the official Gazette by the Federal Government is
of opinion that the sale of such article or vehicle is for the benefit of its owner,
he may, with the approval of the Special Court, after due notice to the owner
and by public auction, direct that the article or as the case may be, the
vehicle be sold in accordance with the rules made under this Act and the sale
proceeds shall be deposited in the National Fund for Drug Abuse till the final
judgment of the Court."; and
(b) for
subsection (3) the following shall be substituted, gamely:--
"(3) If on adjudication or,
as the case may be, in case appeal the vehicle or, as the case may be, an
article so sold is found not have been liable to such confiscation, the entire
sale proceeds shall be handed over to the owner."
